decisions.title: Name sandboxd-server; files via protocol; SFTP demoted to bootstrap; thin fallback
decisions.rationale: Chosen over stdio on ssh channel / unix socket+direct-tcpip — why-not: L4 would die with connection — tunnel in JSON, not protocol dialogue

decisions.title: vscode lifecycle: version handshake/auto-reinstall pin/single connection+events/discovery/reattach/idle TTL/GC
decisions.rationale: Chosen over build our own lifecycle / adopt vscode semantics verbatim — why-not: proven mechanics; commit-pin becomes proto_version handshake

decisions.title: Docker axis does NOT deploy companion; unify contract vocabulary not deployments
decisions.rationale: Chosen over companion for both axes / daemon-as-companion for docker — why-not: zero-value hop; daemon already resident peer with process registry+events

decisions.title: workdir: fence -> safe-box; invariant unchanged, role = durability guarantee only
decisions.rationale: Chosen over keep fence / keep invariant, drop permission semantics — why-not: agent freedom; bind-mount translation stays as fast-path basis

decisions.title: pid truth: handoff capture + starttime identity + pidfd endgame; exit code via wrapper file
decisions.rationale: Chosen over trust pid blindly / handoff+starttime+pidfd — why-not: pid reuse breaks kill -0; wrong-kill is the worst outcome

decisions.title: One supervisor loop + machine process table; batch probe O(1); restart reconciliation
decisions.rationale: Chosen over observer per handle / single supervisor — why-not: per-handle observers amplify on ssh; table feeds L5 reattach

decisions.title: Large files: whole-file base64 + 10MB cap; streaming deferred
decisions.rationale: Chosen over chunked streaming now / cap+defer — why-not: agent files are configs/code; YAGNI

decisions.title: Binary read: detect and reject with bounded exec-pipe advice
decisions.rationale: Chosen over auto base64 everything / reject+advise — why-not: context tax of misread binaries; honest refusal

decisions.title: Path freedom both axes: whole machine / whole container namespace
decisions.rationale: Chosen over workdir-only files / full-path freedom — why-not: machine-is-env; user ruling: capability liberation

decisions.title: docker non-workspace via exec channel; workspace keeps host fast path
decisions.rationale: Chosen over exec for everything / dual-track — why-not: bind-mount translation is real physics worth using

decisions.title: durable flag on file ops + description honesty
decisions.rationale: Chosen over silent freedom / disclose durability — why-not: freedom misread as persistence = surprise data loss

decisions.title: unix socket + ssh direct-tcpip; JSON lines + request-id + server events
decisions.rationale: Chosen over TCP+token / socket+tunnel — why-not: no new ports; auth rides ssh; L4 natural

decisions.title: Trust: semi-auto default (human confirms start); full-auto config default OFF
decisions.rationale: Chosen over full auto vscode-style / semi-auto default — why-not: deploy-time gate, not per-op review — philosophy compatible

decisions.title: Four waves: pkg/file+docker-exec-channel / companion skeleton / supervisor+ledger / files protocol
decisions.rationale: Chosen over one big bang / four independent waves — why-not: each wave verifiable+committable; build context last

decisions.title: Reinstall pinning: sha256+approver audited at first deploy; auto-install only pinned hash; cap 2 then thin-lock
decisions.rationale: Chosen over auto reinstall on mismatch / pinned reinstall — why-not: D-02 x D-13 = permanent unattended deploy channel (RT R1-1 critical)

decisions.title: Socket auth: random token in conn.json 0600 + dir 0700; fail-closed handshake
decisions.rationale: Chosen over trust local users / token auth — why-not: any local process could own a full exec/file daemon (RT R1-2 critical)

decisions.title: Reject uid0 unless allow_root; companion_uid in status; unprivileged install guide
decisions.rationale: Chosen over allow root / root guard — why-not: humans paste sudo by default; agent reach = companion privilege (RT R1-5)

decisions.title: conn.json atomic write; corrupt state -> probe->adopt->thin (never reinstall); owner_id isolation
decisions.rationale: Chosen over reinstall on any anomaly / degrade chain + owner isolation — why-not: heaviest op never as UNKNOWN fallback; two daemons = corruption mode (RT R2-1/2)

decisions.title: exec idempotency: client-request-id + TTL dedup; L3 errors carry surviving handle_id
decisions.rationale: Chosen over at-least-once raw / idempotent exec — why-not: heartbeat false-positive -> retry -> duplicate rsync/apply race (RT R2-3)

decisions.title: starttime parser spec (last-paren split + golden tests); os/arch in handshake; platform matrix first-class
decisions.rationale: Chosen over implicit linux assumption / explicit matrix — why-not: comm parsing trap -> wrong-kill; Windows lacks socket//proc/pidfd (RT R2-4/R3-1)

decisions.title: Terminal tri-state: exited(code)|signaled(sig)|exit_unknown; never coerce to 0
decisions.rationale: Chosen over code-or-zero / tri-state — why-not: missing exit file must stay honest ledger fact (RT R2-5)

decisions.title: Capability probe at declare-time; container_stopped explicit error
decisions.rationale: Chosen over assume sshd defaults / probe + explicit container_stopped — why-not: disabled forwarding = undefined mode; silent docker start = destructive surprise (RT R2-6)

decisions.title: companion boot rescans handle dirs (symmetric self-heal); GC never deletes live-pid dirs (injection test)
decisions.rationale: Chosen over memory-only table / disk-backed + rescan — why-not: companion crash loses pgid bindings; mtime GC kills running daemon dir (RT R3-2)

decisions.title: Per-machine process cap (default 256) enforced at exec-async; O(1) fd/handle stress gate 1k
decisions.rationale: Chosen over uncapped / hard cap — why-not: agent loop -> fd exhaustion -> fake machine-down -> reconnect storm (RT R3-3)

decisions.title: Bidirectional max_line_bytes=32MB with framing error; conformance test
decisions.rationale: Chosen over unbounded lines / bounded framing — why-not: 10MB b64 = 13.7MB line; bufio 64KB silent truncation classic (RT R3-4)

decisions.title: Injection test gates: kill -9 companion->L5 reattach; iptables drop-><=15s+handle_id; mismatch->thin
decisions.rationale: Chosen over prose five layers / named injection harness — why-not: unverifiable = unconstrained (RT R3-5)

decisions.title: durable invariant contract gate: table-driven durable flags + workdir invariant test
decisions.rationale: Chosen over narrative only / evidence gate — why-not: reframing enforced by test not prose (RT R3-7)

decisions.title: status wording agent-neutral: 'mode: thin (managed by operator)'; descriptions never teach install
decisions.rationale: Chosen over install hints in desc / neutral wording — why-not: agents would self-install past the human trust gate (RT R1-6)

decisions.title: Bounded danger advice (<10MB single file); all platform-printed commands via quoting fn + contract test
decisions.rationale: Chosen over free-text advice / bounded + quoted — why-not: weak models run tar on /; unquoted interpolation is the injection vector (RT R1-4)

decisions.title: Cap enforced at protocol layer; search ceiling 300s; trust row in audit; quiet logging + level in handshake
decisions.rationale: Chosen over client-side checks / server-side enforcement — why-not: second client bypasses client checks; privacy asymmetry must be stated (RT R1-3/R3-6)

observable_truths.description: bootstrap writes conn.json (0600) with token; sandboxd reports mode:companion in status
async exec on companion machine returns handle; after process death ledger row flips dead with honest terminal state; visible via events
iptables drop: in-flight exec fails fast with handle_id; machine disconnected <=15s; on recovery L5 reattach and handle remains waitable
docker container non-workspace path file_read/file_write succeed via exec channel; workspace keeps host fast path; responses carry durable flag
proto mismatch with pinned sha256 reinstalls; unpinned hash falls back to thin with needs_reinstall; cap 2 then thin-lock

changelog_user_summary: T2: machine mode enum thin/companion/degraded wired into status with agent-neutral wording per D-01/D-29
